title: Two constructions of selector pair laws
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\theta\in[-1,1]$. The law formed by sampling two independent vectors from $\pi^{\otimes n}$ and applying independent coordinatewise correlated sign pairs to select the two outputs is the same as the law formed by independently sampling, at each coordinate, the one-coordinate pair distribution obtained by that procedure.
